Alibi labels

One run at a time. The page reads the run's blurred crops and marks from this server and saves nothing; your labels leave as a JSON download for eval/labels/.

Look for marks first with the system's marks hidden ("First pass" in the bar), adding each one you see, then show them and judge every box. Click a box to cycle it: real, not real, not judged. Or use the buttons under each crop. For a mark that is not real, say why: a reflection, dirt, or something else. For a real mark, fix its size if the system got it wrong.

Click an empty spot on a crop to add a mark the system missed, with the type and size set in the bar above. With the keyboard, focus a crop, press Enter to add a mark at its centre, move it with the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps) and remove it with Delete. On the return walk, say for each real mark whether it is new since pickup or was there at pickup.

For every panel, say whether it changed between the walks and how well each walk filmed it: filmed means at least 85% of the panel in the frame, in focus, at 3% of the frame or more, in at least one frame; glimpsed means less of it, or smaller or blurred; not filmed means none of it. Tick "all marks checked" for a walk once every system mark on its crops has a call and you have looked for missed marks; the box stays off until every mark has a call, and turns off again if one goes back to not judged.

Labels follow the walkaround_labels_v1 schema in eval/README.md. scripts/eval_run.py reads them; hand marks go through the same whitening as the system's marks.
